summary.content:
Today's selection covers 60 articles from 7 trusted sources, including 35 on Artificial Intelligence and 18 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Anthropic and Wall Street Giants Join Forces to Create New A.I. Firm
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Live updates from Elon Musk and Sam Altman’s court battle over the future of OpenAI
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from NY Times Tech, BleepingComputer, The Verge, TechCrunch, SecurityWeek and others
• **Fresh Content**: 41 articles published in the last 24 hours
